messages:
olivia: hi finance team 10am emergency: corpcard declined when buying a UK travel SIM + oyster top-up at the airport. paid on personal card. receipts here: https://expensify.com/receipts/ghj789 and photo of SIM box attached. total A3 48.60. can i get reimbursed today?
sam (Finance Ops): sorry about the decline. can you confirm vendor name on receipt and whether the SIM invoice is to you (personal) or to Redwood? we need the merchant name + MCC for the card team. also, which currency do you want reimbursement in? we normally refund in the card currency (GBP) or convert to USD at company rate.
olivia: vendor: Heathrow Travel Tech Ltd (MCC 4814). SIM is sold to me personally, no invoice to company. prefer GBP refund to the card used. i also topped up Oyster A3 12.00 cash (no receipt) 1; that's personal commute. do we reimburse transit top-ups?
card-bot: CardBot: corporate cards will decline some retail/telecom MCCs for overseas purchases. per-transaction foreign purchase limit is A3 75. to request permanent MCC allowlist submit https://redwood.atlassian.net/secure/TC-777.
sam (Finance Ops): for the SIM (card-present retail), if paid personally we can reimburse net amount. since vendor invoice is to you, VAT cannot be reclaimed. we'll reimburse the gross A3 amount. for Oyster top-up we reimburse only when receipt uploaded; without a receipt we need a photo of the machine or a bank trace. policy note: daily commute top-ups are reimbursable while traveling on company business, but mark as non-taxable per People Ops.
olivia: got it. uploaded bank screenshot for the Oyster top-up: https://expensify.com/receipts/oyst123. expense submitted in Expensify under project LON-ENG, tag `travel-local`. set refund currency to GBP and DM'd card last4 1111. @mika for non-taxable confirmation.
mika (People Ops): confirmed 10: non-taxable as long as vendor invoice is to employee and it's a travel commute expense while on trip. just flag `travel-commute` and include dates in expense. we'll annotate payroll record.
sam (Finance Ops): approving now. accounting preview: refund A3 48.60 (SIM) + A3 12.00 (Oyster) = A3 60.60. we'll process GBP refund to the card used. accounting ref ACCT-2026-777. expedited flag set; target payment same business day. please allow 1-2 business days for bank settlement.
olivia: thanks!! saved my trip. :relieved:
sam (Finance Ops): one more note 10; since VAT can't be reclaimed on personal invoice, code as travel expense (GL 6102) and mark VAT = 0. include the merchant copy of the SIM packaging if available.
olivia: attached SIM photo in the expense. thanks again.
